    • MoveRecord

      public MoveRecord(int fromRow, int fromCol, int toRow, int toCol, ChessPiece moved, ChessPiece captured)
      Creates a completed move record.
      Parameters:
      fromRow - starting row, zero-based
      fromCol - starting column, zero-based
      toRow - destination row, zero-based
      toCol - destination column, zero-based
      moved - piece that moved
      captured - opponent piece that was captured, or null
